description: Fixed list of red-flag symptoms. Every message is checked against this list (plus the LLM) BEFORE anything else. A match shows the free emergency response and nothing is queued. Each flag: { id, label, patterns: [lowercase phrases, English and Pidgin], category? }.
reviewStatus: DRAFT — requires review and sign-off by a qualified nurse, midwife or doctor before any production or demo use. Phrasing, wording coverage and clinical relevance are not yet clinically validated. This list is not exhaustive and must not be treated as a complete safety net: phrase matching is one layer only, alongside the LLM's own independent judgement (see apps/api/prompts/assistant.md). Failing to match a phrase here does not mean a message is safe.
matching: Patterns are matched as case-insensitive substrings against the lowercased message text. This is intentionally a coarse, conservative net for near-exact phrasing; natural variation in how something is written may not match literally, which is why the LLM layer exists alongside it.
